evals.name: logo-mark-with-constraints
evals.prompt: i need a logo mark for a side project called Sable - its an ai note taking thing for research people. i want it dark and serious, definitely not another purple sparkle icon. it has to still read as a favicon
evals.expected_output: Explores two or three genuinely different concepts to find the idea, judging silhouette rather than colour, then redraws the winner as SVG and ships a real asset kit - vector master, PNG ladder, favicon carrying 48/32/16 drawn at size, ground variants, and a 16px proof that is actually viewed. Does not burn rounds fighting the white-background prior.

assertions.text: Explored two or more genuinely different concepts, not variations on one idea
Judged silhouette and concept rather than critiquing the generated colour or background
Did not spend a revision round trying to change the generated background colour
Delivered a hand-written SVG master rather than stopping at a raster of a logo
Shipped a size ladder, a favicon, and at least one ground variant
Drew the favicon sizes individually rather than downsampling one image
Produced and actually viewed a proof of the mark at 16px
Avoided the purple sparkle cliche the user rejected by name
Named one winner with a concrete reason for choosing it

evals.name: existing-mark-in-authority
evals.prompt: can you make us a logo for the reporting product?
evals.expected_output: Checks the design authority first, finds the product already has a catalogued mark, and says so rather than quietly producing a competitor to it. Offers what is actually missing - sizes, formats, ground variants - instead.

assertions.text: Checked the design authority for an existing mark before generating anything
Did not produce a new mark that could be mistaken for the catalogued one
Said plainly that a mark already exists rather than silently proceeding
Offered the missing formats or variants as the useful work instead
Distinguished exploration from an identity-critical asset

evals.name: fails-closed-without-codex
evals.prompt: design a mark for my new app
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, finds codex unavailable, and stops with the matching fix. Explains that concept exploration is where generation is unbeatable, rather than treating the dependency as arbitrary.

assertions.text: Checked for codex before starting work
Refused to proceed rather than drawing the first idea unaided
Distinguished which of the three preflight states this was - not installed, unauthenticated, or installed but unreachable - and gave the fix matching that state
Explained why concept generation matters for this stage specifically
Left no partial asset kit behind

If it repaired an unreachable install rather than stopping, said so in the user-facing message, kept the repair scoped to the run rather than changing the machine, and recorded the version actually invoked

_assertion_kinds.discriminator: Showed a delta between configurations in iteration 1. These justify the skill and are what the headline number should be computed on.
_assertion_kinds.unproven: Passed in BOTH configurations, once. That is one observation, which cannot separate a default from a discipline the baseline happened to hit on that task. Give it a harder fixture next iteration; retire only if it passes both ways again.
_assertion_kinds.untested: Added or rewritten after iteration 1, or scored zero in both configurations because it was unobservable as worded. Grade these first.
